scope: Extend the local partial-DWG-read CLI controls across every supported DWG writer revision.

control.sourceProfile: Each source is authored at runtime from scratch and contains one non-finite LINE rejected by the entity parser, followed by one valid LINE.

cases.expect: Each source read reports one entity parse failure; strict export refuses and preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
Each source warns that partial mode is explicit and owner/reference checks remain strict, then publishes same-revision ASCII DXF containing exactly the retained LINE.
Each published DXF reopens with exactly one LINE and neither the source nor first output changes.

validation.test: PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter $PWD/build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer $PWD/build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --partial-read-only (18 controls); PASS: same command with --fast-only (103 option, 47 batch, 2 read-observation, 18 partial-read and 4 source-disposition controls)

limits: Generated controls cover one entity-parse failure shape per writer revision; other failure patterns remain open.
These controls do not qualify external source profiles, DWG owner/reference failures as partial-output eligible, or overall format support.
AC1012/AC1014 DWG-source output/readback and broader repair/skip/mask projections remain separate CLI contracts.
